agenda_briefs.title: Proposed: Burnaby fee changes to take effect January 1, 2027
agenda_briefs.summary: Council is set to consider amendments to the Burnaby Consolidated Fees and Charges Bylaw. A proposed bylaw change would update various municipal fees and charges, with the new rates slated to take effect on January 1, 2027. The specific fees affected have not yet been detailed in the agenda item, but any business that pays municipal fees for licences, permits, or services in Burnaby could be impacted. Council will vote on this proposal at an upcoming meeting.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Watch for the council decision and review the detailed fee schedule once published to see if your business's fees will change.

key_dates.label: Proposed Burnaby fee changes take effect

agenda_briefs.source_body:
7.1
BURNABY CONSOLIDATED FEES AND CHARGES BYLAW - FEE CHANGES FOR JANUARY 1, 2027
Purpose: To propose amendments to the Burnaby Consolidated Fees and Charges Bylaw effective January 1, 2027.

agenda_briefs.title: Proposed: Burnaby Council to weigh comment on Surrey Metro 2050 amendment
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to consider sending a comment letter to the Metro Vancouver Regional District Board about a proposed amendment to the Metro 2050 Regional Growth Strategy. The amendment, Bylaw No. 1463, 2026, would change the regional growth plan for a site at 105-175A Street in Surrey. This is a proposed change that has not been approved yet. If you operate in the region, this could affect future planning and development patterns, though the direct impact on Burnaby businesses is still being reviewed.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Monitor the council decision and any regional planning updates that could affect development or transportation in the region.
agenda_briefs.industries: Construction & Development, Landlord & Property Mgmt, Transportation & Logistics
agenda_briefs.source_body:
7.2

Purpose:
To provide Council with the opportunity to consider forwarding a comment letter to the Metro Vancouver Regional District Board in response to Amendment Bylaw No. 1463, 2026 to amend the Metro 2050 Regional Growth Strategy.

agenda_briefs.title: Council to consider comment letter on Metro 2050 amendment for Molson Site
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to consider forwarding a comment letter to the Metro Vancouver Regional District Board about Amendment Bylaw No. 1470, 2026. This proposed bylaw would amend the Metro 2050 Regional Growth Strategy to change how the Molson Site in Vancouver is planned for future growth. If approved, the amendment could affect regional land-use planning and development patterns that may impact Burnaby businesses. Council will decide whether to submit comments on this proposed change.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Watch for Council's decision on the comment letter — this regional planning change could affect future development and business conditions in Burnaby.
agenda_briefs.source_body:

agenda_briefs.title: Proposed: Burnaby Council to vote on Swangard Stadium LED lighting contract
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to vote on awarding a construction contract for the LED lighting upgrade at Swangard Stadium. The proposed project would replace the stadium's current lighting with energy-efficient LED fixtures. If approved, the contract would be awarded to a construction company to carry out the work. This is a proposed decision and has not yet been approved.
agenda_briefs.action_required: No action needed from business owners at this time, but watch for the council decision if you operate near the stadium.
agenda_briefs.source_body:
7.4
CA - SWANGARD STADIUM LED LIGHTING - CONSTRUCTION
Purpose:
To obtain Council approval for a Contract Award (CA) for the Swangard Stadium LED Lighting upgrade.

agenda_briefs.title: Proposed: Burnaby Council to vote on contract for surplus excavated materials disposal
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to vote on awarding a contract for the transport and disposal of surplus excavated materials (dirt, rock, and other soil) from various City construction sites. This is a proposed decision that has not yet been approved. If approved, the contract would cover the removal and disposal of excess materials generated by City building projects. The decision is on the Council agenda and will be considered at an upcoming meeting.
agenda_briefs.action_required: No direct action needed, but construction and development firms may want to monitor the decision for potential subcontracting or disposal service opportunities.

agenda_briefs.title: Proposed: Burnaby Council to vote on janitorial supplies contract award
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to vote on a proposed contract award for the supply and delivery of janitorial supplies. If approved, this would select a vendor to provide cleaning products and related items to the city. This is an upcoming decision, not yet final. Businesses that supply janitorial products may want to monitor the outcome, as it could affect future procurement opportunities with the city.
agenda_briefs.action_required: If you supply janitorial products, watch for the council decision and any future procurement notices.

agenda_briefs.title: Council to vote on contract change for Burnaby Heights sewer separation
agenda_briefs.summary: Burnaby Council is set to vote on a proposed contract change for the Burnaby Heights Combined Sewer Separation project (EA-3193). This change would adjust the existing contract for the project, which is designed to separate combined sewers in the Burnaby Heights area. If approved, the change could affect construction timelines, costs, or scope for businesses and residents in the area. The decision is scheduled for an upcoming Council meeting, and the outcome has not yet been determined.
agenda_briefs.action_required: Monitor the Council decision — if approved, the contract change could affect construction timelines or access near your business.

agenda_briefs.summary: Council is set to vote on a proposed contract change for the Royal Oak & Sunland Watermain Replacement & Road Upgrades project.
